statement: numeric.c is the FIRST GnuCOBOL libcob source file ported function-for-function into gnucobol-rs. Every function in the file has a named Rust counterpart (102/102). The project does NOT claim a clean-room implementation for this file: it claims an openly-licensed, provenance-documented, oracle-verified Rust port/reconstruction of the admitted GnuCOBOL 3.2 numeric behaviour.

commit_range.last: ed706a3d (real Mpf; both float directions verified)
commit_range.note: Predecessor byte-courts (ROUND/BIGNUM/INTPOW/LOGICAL/FLOAT/COMP-6/arith) were sealed earlier in the campaign and are aggregated here.

rust_modules: crates/gnucobol-rs/src/packed.rs (PACKED-DECIMAL: converters, comparison, in-place cob_add_bcd, cob_move_bcd, tables)

disabled_in_source_ported_not_wired.reason: These are #if 0-disabled in numeric.c (cob_add_packed/cob_complement_packed marked 'RXWRXW - Buggy'; the display_add_int trio a disabled optimisation). They are NOT compiled into the admitted oracle, so they are ported verbatim for literal 1:1 completeness but NOT wired into any active code path. cob_display_add_int reads `sign` before assignment (undefined behaviour, the bug that disabled it), modeled as 0 with an explicit note. Their behaviour is, by definition, not oracle-verifiable.

sealed_courts_aggregated: GNURUST.ROUND.1 + ROUND.2 (8 rounding modes, display + packed)

differential_verification.note: All against the admitted GnuCOBOL 3.2 oracle. FAIL=0 across every sweep.
differential_verification.get_double_direction: decimal->mpf->mpf_get_d is bit-identical to the FLOAT.1-sealed decimal_to_f64_trunc (unit cross-check).

non_claims: Full-precision mpf use BEYOND numeric.c's byte path (the intrinsic functions in intr.c exercise the 2048-bit mpf at >double precision; that is intr.c's port, not this file's).
Business/accounting correctness of any computed value (bytes are witnessed, not the meaning).
ON SIZE ERROR / NOT ON SIZE ERROR control flow (the exception register side effects live in the statement-execution layer, not the numeric kernel).
Procedure-Division execution, COMPUTE expression evaluation, and edited-field formatting (separate courts/files).
The #if 0-disabled functions' behaviour (not in the oracle; ported but unverifiable).

license_boundary.statement: This is a FAITHFUL DERIVATIVE PORT of GnuCOBOL 3.2's numeric.c, not a clean-room reimplementation. The GnuCOBOL source is vendored (research/gnucobol-3.2.tar.lz, GPL) and admitted as the oracle; the Rust port mirrors its function names and algorithms and is therefore a derivative work, licensed LGPL-3.0-or-later to honour the copyleft. The Apache-licensed KOBOLD layer NEVER mixes with this LGPL numeric port (the GPL partition is enforced by reports/license/gpl-license-guard-receipt.json).
